feed.title: Huiheng Li

entry.content:
I am a year 2 undergraduate of Department of Computer Science, University of Warwick. My major is Computer Systems Engineering (aka Electronics and Computer Engineering, ECE). My personal tutor is Dr. Davi De Castro Silva. I am one of this year’s Tencent Global Campus Ambassadors.

Email: Huiheng.Li@warwick.ac.uk or huihengli66@outlook.com
Feel Free to contact me about anything!

Research interests (so far)

  • AI Security
  • AI-enabled security attack and defense drills
  • Application of AI in Security Protection
  • Financial Technology
